prompt.project_info: Photorealistic outdoor patio fashion portrait with a lilac activewear-inspired open-back one-piece and soft greenery.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with dark brown hair in a high messy ponytail, chunky blonde face-framing highlights, warm light-tan skin, defined brows, winged eyeliner, matte mauve lipstick and supplied small hand/wrist tattoo.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle medium-full shot from head to bare feet. Stand angled away on light-grey pavers, twist naturally to look over the left shoulder, left hand near the collarbone and right arm relaxed. Wear a fitted long-sleeved lavender mini dress or romper with matte stretch fabric and large open-back cutout; preserve ruched seam detail and white toenail polish.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused overcast or open-shade daylight, shallow depth of field, textured stucco wall at left and blurred green residential foliage behind.
prompt.technical_specs: Sharp subject focus with slight background bokeh, high-angle perspective, medium-full vertical framing, natural skin and matte-fabric texture, realistic daylight.

Use a high-angle medium-full shot from the top of her head to her bare feet.
